Rashi on Berakhot 60a:10:1.english: What is it? - For example, where one found a lost object.

Rashi on Berakhot 60a:13:1.hebrew: שלא יסריח - הזרע, אלא יקלוט ויהיה ולד. ולאחר שלשה ימים, אם לא קלט, כבר הסריח ואין תפלה מועלת:
Rashi on Berakhot 60a:13:1.english: That it not putrefy - [That] the seed [not putrefy], but rather take hold and become a fetus. And after three days, if it has not taken hold, it has already putrefied, and prayer is of no avail.

Rashi on Berakhot 60a:13:2.hebrew: שלא יהא סנדל - שלא תתעבר אשתו ולד אחר, ויהיה פוחת צורתו של ראשון, ודומה לדג של ים ששמו סנדל. הכי אמרינן במס' נדה (דף כה:): סנדל דומה לסנדל של ים, ומתחלתו ולד היה אלא שנרצף — משל לאדם שסטר את חבירו והחזיר צורתו לאחוריו:
Rashi on Berakhot 60a:13:2.english: That it not be a sandal [fetus] - That his wife not conceive another fetus, which would impair the form of the first and [cause it to] resemble a fish of the sea named sandal. This is what we say in Tractate Niddah (25b): "A sandal [fetus] resembles a sea sandal; and originally it was a [viable] fetus, but it was crushed — a parable to a person who slapped his fellow and turned his features backward."

Rashi on Berakhot 60a:14:1.hebrew: ומי מהני - תפלה לזכר, אפילו בתוך ארבעים יום? והלא הדבר תלוי בהזרעה תחלה:
Rashi on Berakhot 60a:14:1.english: And does [prayer] avail - [Does] prayer [avail] for a male, even within forty days? But is not the matter dependent on who emits seed first?

Rashi on Berakhot 60a:14:2.hebrew: הכי גרסינן - משכחת לה דמהניא, כגון שהזריעו שניהם בבת אחת:
Rashi on Berakhot 60a:14:2.english: This is the reading - You find that [prayer] is effective, for example, where both of them emitted seed simultaneously.

Rashi on Berakhot 60a:16:1.hebrew: כל היכי דדרשת ליה להאי קרא - מדריש לחדא משמעות:
Rashi on Berakhot 60a:16:1.english: Whichever way you interpret this verse - It is interpreted to one meaning.

Rashi on Berakhot 60a:16:2.hebrew: מסיפיה לרישיה מדריש - מי שנכון לבו בטוח ביי', משמועה רעה לא יירא:
Rashi on Berakhot 60a:16:2.english: It is expounded from its end to its beginning - One whose heart is steadfast, trusting in the Lord, shall not be afraid of evil tidings.

Rashi on Berakhot 60a:17:1.hebrew: בדברי תורה כתיב - אשרי אדם מפחד תמיד — שמא תשתכח ממנו, שמתוך כך הוא מחזיר לשנותם תמיד:
Rashi on Berakhot 60a:17:1.english: It is written regarding words of Torah - "Happy is the man that fears always" — [he fears] lest it be forgotten by him, for because of this, he always returns to review them.

Rashi on Berakhot 60a:1:1.hebrew: דקנה וחזר וקנה דברי הכל אין צריך לברך - דהא רבי יוחנן לא אמר צריך לברך, אלא משום דלענין קנייה חדש הוא:
Rashi on Berakhot 60a:1:1.english: That [if] he purchased and then purchased again, everyone agrees that he is not required to recite a blessing - For Rabbi Yoḥanan only said that he is required to recite a blessing because with regard to purchasing, it is new [to him].

Rashi on Berakhot 60a:20:1.hebrew: תנו רבנן - בן עזאי אמרה, דאמר שתים בכניסתו ושתים ביציאתו:
Rashi on Berakhot 60a:20:1.english: The Sages taught - Ben Azzai stated it, for he said: "Two upon his entrance and two upon his exit."

Rashi on Berakhot 60a:21:1.hebrew: לית לן בה - יזהר בעצמו שלא יפשע, או אם פשע כבר, אל יכנס במקום סכנה:
Rashi on Berakhot 60a:21:1.english: We have no concern about it - He should take care of himself not to act negligently, or if he has already acted negligently, let him not enter a place of danger.

Rashi on Berakhot 60a:27:2.hebrew: מתותיה - חפירה שהמים נופלים לתוכה, ובני אדם רוחצים על גבי תקרה שעל גבה:
Rashi on Berakhot 60a:27:2.english: Beneath him - [There is] a pit into which the water falls, and people bathe on top of a ceiling that is above it.

Rashi on Berakhot 60a:27:3.hebrew: בחד אבריה - בזרועו החזיק אחד או שנים, וזה בזה החזיקו עד מאה ואחד:
Rashi on Berakhot 60a:27:3.english: With one of his limbs - With his arm he held one or two [people], and they held onto one another, up to one hundred and one.

Rashi on Berakhot 60a:27:4.hebrew: היינו דרבי אחא - דבעי אודויי שהוצאתני לשלום:
Rashi on Berakhot 60a:27:4.english: This is [what was said by] Rabbi Aḥa - For he requires [one] to give thanks: "That You brought me out in peace."

Rashi on Berakhot 60a:28:1.hebrew: שאין דרכן של בני אדם וכו' - כלומר, לא היה להם לעסוק ברפואות, אלא לבקש רחמים:
Rashi on Berakhot 60a:28:1.english: Because it is not the way of people, etc. - That is to say, they should not have engaged in medical treatments, but rather prayed for mercy.

Rashi on Berakhot 60a:2:1.hebrew: ואיכא דאמרי כו' מכלל דכי יש לו וקנה דברי הכל צריך לברך - דהא רב הונא לא אמר אין צריך לברך אלא דקנה וחזר וקנה, דליכא חדוש כלל. אבל יש לו וקנה, דאיכא חדוש — מודה הוא דצריך:
Rashi on Berakhot 60a:2:1.english: And some say, etc.: By inference, if he has [one] and purchased [another], everyone agrees that he must recite a blessing - For Rav Huna only said that he does not need to recite a blessing where he purchased and then purchased again, since there is no novelty at all. But where he has [one] and purchased [another], since there is novelty — he concedes that he must [recite a blessing].

Rashi on Berakhot 60a:3:1.hebrew: בין כך ובין כך - בין שיש לו, בין שאין לו — הואיל ולא קנה הראשונים ועכשיו קנה, צריך לברך:
Rashi on Berakhot 60a:3:1.english: In either case - Whether he has [similar ones] or whether he does not have [similar ones] — since he did not purchase the first ones and now he purchased [these], he must recite a blessing.

Rashi on Berakhot 60a:4:1.hebrew: לא כרבי מאיר ולא כרבי יהודה - דאפילו רבי יהודה לא פליג אלא ביש לו וקנה, אבל בקנה וחזר וקנה — לא:
Rashi on Berakhot 60a:4:1.english: Neither in accordance with Rabbi Meir nor in accordance with Rabbi Yehuda - For even Rabbi Yehuda only disagreed in [a case where] one [already] has [similar items] and purchased [new ones], but in [a case where] one purchased and purchased again, [he did] not.

Rashi on Berakhot 60a:8:1.hebrew: דמסקא ארעא שרטון - לימ"ץ מחמת המים, והוה ליה לזבל:
Rashi on Berakhot 60a:8:1.english: That the land brings up sediment - Limoz [in Old French, meaning silt] due to the water, and it serves as fertilizer for him.

Rashi on Berakhot 60a:8:2.hebrew: השתא מיהא רעה היא - שמחבלת תבואה של שנה זו, ומברך ברוך דיין האמת:
Rashi on Berakhot 60a:8:2.english: At present, in any case, it is bad - For it ruins the produce of this year, and he recites: "Blessed is the true Judge."

Rashi on Berakhot 60a:9:1.hebrew: ועל הטוב שהיא מעין הרעה - יברך הטוב והמטיב:
Rashi on Berakhot 60a:9:1.english: And for the good that is of the nature of the bad - He recites: "Who is good and Who does good."
